terms.rule: A party asserting an economic obligation against the patient must provide evidence sufficient to substantiate the assertion.
Ambiguity, missing evidence, or a later billing assertion does not by itself establish patient responsibility.
Patient transaction terms presented before service and evidence of their receipt must be preserved.
Subsequent provider performance after receipt is preserved as transaction evidence; StegVerse does not independently adjudicate its legal effect.
MyKV evaluates evidenced economic pathways and presents them to the patient; it does not select a pathway for the patient.
